name: Biological Chemistry Program (PhD)
summary: Interdepartmental Biological Chemistry PhD training at the interface of biology and chemistry.

applicationFee.note: $55 domestic; $65 international. Fall2027 domestic waiver code MBBCUTAHPHD, program-specific. No international fee waivers or faculty sponsorship; fees not refundable.

english.toefl: 80 iBT old scale or4.5 new scale
english.note: Official electronic scores within two years of application/payment. Qualifying citizenship/education exemptions apply; English instruction alone is insufficient. See central policy for approved countries and recency.

documents: PDF scans of official transcripts from every college/university
Research statement (2–3 pages): interests, goals, research experience, program/faculty fit
requirements.note: Only one BC/MB application per cycle; maximum three applications overall. Rank ten faculty interests and enter full-time-equivalent research months. Three signed letters on letterhead through Slate dueDecember1; up to four accepted. Science background and meaningful research competitive; coursework gaps can be remedied. Do not upload unrequested awards/publications. InterviewsJanuary–March; decisionsFebruary–March.

international.note: For2027–28 only international applicants currently in the United States holding valid nonimmigrant status will be considered. Applicants outside the U.S. are ineligible.

funding.note: Accepted students receive stipend, tuition waiver, health insurance and$1000startingallocation. Published stipend is2026–27, Fall2027 amount unconfirmed. Continued support requires good standing; BC guarantee no longer applies if thesis lab outsideprogram.
